facts.text: Brandeis was established in 1948 as a nonsectarian university under the sponsorship of the American Jewish community.

sources.title: Mission and Diversity Statements - Brandeis University
sources.quote: Brandeis was founded in 1948 as a nonsectarian university under the sponsorship of the American Jewish community to embody its highest ethical and cultural values and to express its gratitude to the United States

facts.text: Brandeis University requires all undergraduate students to complete a University Writing Seminar during their first year.

sources.title: University Writing Seminar | Courses of Instruction
sources.quote: The University Writing Seminar, which all students complete during their first year, emphasizes writing as a means of thinking, exploring, and understanding.
